title: Caching Strategies
supports: Lazy loading reads the cache, then the database on a miss, then writes the cache; the miss penalty; stale data without write updates; TTL bounds staleness; a replaced empty node increases latency and database queries

title: Caching Guidance
relevantSections: Determine how to cache data effectively; Invalidate on write; Manage data expiration; Handle cache unavailability; Caching and eventual consistency
supports: Seeding a cache; invalidate on write and its read race; too short or too long expiry; falling back to the data store when the cache is unavailable, which can swamp it

title: RFC 5861: HTTP Cache-Control Extensions for Stale Content
supports: When an error is encountered, a cached stale response may be used to satisfy the request (stale-if-error)

title: Package singleflight
supports: Only one execution is in flight per key; duplicate callers wait for the original and receive the same result (request coalescing)

title: Caffeine: Refresh
supports: Refresh keeps returning the old value while the key reloads asynchronously, unlike expiration, which makes readers wait (refresh-ahead)

title: TinyLFU: A Highly Efficient Cache Admission Policy
organization: ACM Transactions on Storage 13(4), 2017 (Einziger, Friedman, Manes)
supports: Frequency-based admission and eviction for caches under skewed access; further reading beyond this module, which models no eviction
